# `reg query HKLM\HARDWARE\DEVICEMAP\SERIALCOMM` on a Windows ground station, in registry order.
# Hand-made, modelled on a real machine: the motherboard UART, an ArduPilot board on usbser.sys,
# an FTDI adapter, and the two ports Windows creates for a paired Bluetooth SPP radio.

HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\HARDWARE\DEVICEMAP\SERIALCOMM
    \Device\Serial0    REG_SZ    COM1
    \Device\USBSER000    REG_SZ    COM3
    \Device\VCP0    REG_SZ    COM4
    \Device\BthModem0    REG_SZ    COM10
    \Device\BthModem1    REG_SZ    COM11
